About us

At Gilman Visual Media, we believe the most powerful images are the ones that reflect real life. In a world full of heavy filters and over-processed edits, our focus is simple: deliver clean, authentic, and timeless photography that captures genuine moments as they actually happen.

We specialize in realistic, raw storytelling. Whether we are covering events, portraits, commercial work, or life’s natural milestones, our goal isn't to reshape reality—it’s to preserve it. We keep our editing intentional and minimal, allowing natural light, true colors, and honest emotion to take center stage.﻿

Mystery is not about traveling to new places but about looking with new eyes.
MARCEL PROUST

Real Estate 

Capture your property with crisp, well-lit imagery that accurately presents the layout, space, and architectural detail without distorted wide angles or unnatural color shifts.

What’s Included: High-resolution interior and exterior shots, natural lighting balance, standard image correction, and digital delivery ready for MLS or marketing listings.

Pricing & Turnaround Expectations: Starting at $175–$300 (scaled by square footage). Typical delivery within 24–48 hours.

STARTING FROM
$175
Drone Add-on

Overview: Elevate your real estate listings with true-to-life aerial imagery that showcases the complete property line, surrounding neighborhood, roof condition, and acreage.

What’s Included: High-resolution aerial exterior photos, essential surrounding area shots, natural color adjustments (no unnatural sky replacements or fake grass), and web-ready digital files delivered alongside your standard interior package.

Stand-Alone Session: $150–$250

Add-On Exterior Package: $100–$125

Turnaround: 24–48 hours

STARTING FROM
$100
INQUIRE

No Hidden Fees

Clear, upfront rates with high-resolution digital files included in every session package.

Aerial Real Estate & Land Photography

Showcase small residential lots, commercial buildings, or multi-acre properties with clear, well-framed aerial views.

Best For: Real estate agents, land sales, commercial developments, and private land owners.

What’s Included: High-resolution aerial stills covering multiple angles, heights, and boundary perspectives.

Expectations: Delivery within 24–48 hours. Custom quotes based on acreage and location.

STARTING FROM
$150
Roof & Property Inspection Photography

Obtain detailed, high-resolution visual evidence of roofs, structures, and land features without requiring scaffolding, ladders, or risky manual inspection.

Best For: Property managers, homeowners, contractors, insurance documentation, and pre-purchase property assessments.

What’s Included: Close-up, multi-angle aerial imagery focusing on shingles, gutters, chimneys, siding, and overall structural condition.

Expectations: Standard delivery within 24–48 hours with organized photo documentation.

STARTING FROM
$ 175
Aerial Surveying & Mapping Support

Clear visual documentation for site progress, property boundaries, acreage evaluation, and land assessment.

Best For: Construction progress monitoring, farm/land management, and property development updates.

What’s Included: High-altitude orthomosaic-style imagery, site overview documentation, and routine progress shoots (weekly/monthly options available).

Expectations: Project-based custom pricing. Flexible scheduling for multi-phase sites.

STARTING FROM
$ 300
INQUIRE
Why Choose us?
FAA Certified

Operated legally and safely under FAA commercial drone regulations with full liability coverage

4K & RAW Imaging

Crisp, clear aerial captures that retain fine detail for inspection, print, or web use.

Risk-Free Operations

Fully insured operations prioritizing site safety, clear airspace clearance, and property protection.

Flexible Flight Plans

From one-off real estate shoots to ongoing construction site updates and land documentation.

Note: Aerial mapping support provided by Gilman Visual Media is for visual planning, marketing, site inspection, and progress tracking purposes. Official boundary surveys requiring legal land documentation should be performed by a licensed state land surveyor.

Portraits & Headshots

Individual, creative, or professional headshots and portraits focused on comfortable, natural posing that highlights your genuine expression rather than forced poses.

What’s Included: Guided outdoor or environmental location session, multiple outfit changes (where applicable), custom gallery, and high-resolution digital downloads with full personal use rights.

Pricing & Turnaround Expectations: Starting at $175–$350 per session (typically 45–90 minutes). Delivery within 5–7 business days.

STARTING FROM
$150
Events & Celebrations

From corporate functions and private parties to community gatherings, we document the real atmosphere, key highlights, and candid interactions as they unfold.

What’s Included: Comprehensive hourly coverage, full documentary-style editing focused on true-to-life colors, and an organized online gallery for sharing and downloading.

Pricing & Turnaround Expectations: $150–$250 per hour (minimum coverage hours may apply). Delivery within 1–2 weeks depending on event scale.

STARTING FROM
$150
Weddings & Special Milestones

Honest, timeless coverage of your wedding day or landmark event, prioritizing candid emotion, authentic moments, and true colors over heavy, fleeting trends.

What’s Included: Pre-event consultation, dual-coverage options, high-resolution edited gallery, print release, and private online client gallery access.

Pricing & Turnaround Expectations: Base packages starting at $2,000–$3,000+ depending on hours of coverage. full gallery delivery within 3–5 weeks.

STARTING FROM
$ 2000
Commercial, Pet & Lifestyle Photography

Tailored photography for local businesses, product lifestyle features, automotive, or pet portraits. We craft authentic visual content that matches your brand’s personality and values.

What’s Included: Pre-session planning, flexible location choices, commercial usage licensing, and optimized high-res files formatted for print, web, or social media.

Pricing & Turnaround Expectations: Custom quotes based on scope, starting at $200 per session/project. Delivery within 5–10 business days.
